artifact_observations.reasoning: The skin texture appears overly smooth and waxy, lacking fine pore detail typical of high-res photography. The transition between the glove and the wrist/forearm shows slight blending issues.

The fingers wrapping around the pistol grip and foregrip lack clear definition. The index finger seems to merge slightly with the trigger guard area, and the thumb placement on the upper receiver looks anatomically ambiguous.
The background exhibits a uniform, painterly blur that doesn't perfectly match a natural depth-of-field falloff, suggesting AI-generated background synthesis.
